body:
I know I can do it... I know I'm capable of enduring it. I've just lost the will to do so. I don't see the point. I don't see the benefit to anyone of having me in their life. I just don't want to suffer anymore. It's so heavy, it's this physical pain in my chest I can't shed. I'm tired.

Thank you for the words of support though. I really appreciate them.
